name: 王座之旨武器 Weapon of Throne's Command (BMT)

description.value:
武器（任意），極珍稀（需同調）
這把武器嵌有華麗的金絲，飾以深藍色和栗色的珠寶。你使用該武器進行的攻擊檢定和傷害擲骰獲得+1加值。此外，你獲得威嚇&Reference[skill=Intimidation]和遊說&Reference[skill=Persuasion]兩個技能中你沒有熟練項技能的熟練。
施法Spellcasting。 該武器有5發充能。你可以用一個附贈動作並花費1發或多發充能來施展以下法術之一（豁免 DC 16）： @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack-zh-tw.new-icon.Item.Ja6HpsLeGA9MQ0Rm]{命令術 Command}（1充能）、 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack-zh-tw.new-icon.Item.T4zFq0zTHnzZeO9t]{誠實之域 Zone of Truth}（2充能）、 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack-zh-tw.new-icon.Item.RpBbOYseLZCFXaFY]{強迫術 Compulsion}（4 充能）、 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack-zh-tw.new-icon.Item.lopw7wVkPoE7gbNu]{放逐術 Banishment}（4充能）、@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack-zh-tw.new-icon.Item.JudswpO6E5GBlyfQ]{支配人類 Dominate Person}（5充能）。

該武器每天在黎明時恢復[[/r 1d4]]發已消耗的充能。

This weapon is bedecked in ornate gold filigree and deep-blue and maroon jewels. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this weapon. Additionally, you gain proficiency in the &Reference[skill=Intimidation] and &Reference[skill=Persuasion] skills if you don't already have it.

Spellcasting. The weapon has 5 charges. You can use a bonus action and expend 1 or more of its charges to cast one of the following spells (save DC 16): @spell[Command] (1 charge), @spell[Zone of Truth] (2 charges), @spell[Compulsion] (4 charges), @spell[Banishment] (4 charges), or @spell[Dominate Person] (5 charges).

The weapon regains [[/r 1d4]] expended charges daily at dawn.
